notes: Card: 29/32 peak on ' of' in Duke of, writ of, Peace of, table of, gift of. The - pole is also ' of', but in loose physical/partitive phrases (pan of vegetables, wall of the cubicle), the other side of the distinction. Probe: Duke of 0.72, Treaty of 0.51, bowl of soup 0.37, cup of milk 0.21.
